# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About כבש הכבשים
A community platform called 'Kevesh HaKvasim' (The Sheep's Sheep) focused on Q&A interactions. The name has a playful, quirky character suggesting a fun and informal community vibe with a sheep-themed identity. The platform aims to connect community members through questions and answers in an engaging, community-driven environment.
